notes.title: Untitled
notes.notes: Car physics/game feel updated to be more in line with the main Motor Assailant game.

notes.title: Update 3. Patch notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Rebalanced boost ability so it makes more sense to use it continuously rather than in short bursts only
[*]UI tweaks
[*]Added sound effects to some events
[*]Replaced some old sounds with new ones
[*]Added some destructible rubble to maps
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2. Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Modified physics model of the player vehicle, should be a lot less bouncy and easier to maneuver now
[*]Added some degree of air control. While in air use your movement and steering controls to rotate your vehicle
[*]Enemy vehicles fire is now more precise, especially at later levels
[*]Some memory optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1. Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Missiles now regenerate automatically
[*]Missile pick ups permanently increase maximum number of missiles
[*]Reduced amount of missile pickups on levels
[*]Number of missiles will not be saved on death
[*]Missiles no longer target dead enemies
[*]Main menu now has options to continue or start a new game
[*]New powerup: weapon boost
[/list]

notes.title: Release date postponed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
Unfortunately I had to postpone the release date of Motor Assailant: Prologue by a few days. There is also good news: demo version of the main game [b]Motor Assailant[/b] will become available shortly on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163730]the game page[/url].
